The three AI judges are sealed models running inside trusted execution environments; the product facts name no model or provider, so their identities are not given here.
Anyone checks a ruling on chain by reading the review and vote records the judges post to the job's on-chain entry, where each verdict and its bond are public.

Two of the three decide, and the contract checks each signed vote before a ruling stands.
Anyone checks a ruling on chain by reading the signed votes, and a ruling can be challenged with a bond.

You confirm the payment with 1Click, which shows the incoming transfer so you can mark the order paid.

To copy: buy the key for NEAR, then point an agent at it to mirror the trades as they appear.
